subject: Fix sds unittest tests to check for zmalloc_usable_size (#1314)
reason: The change modifies only unit-test files (src/unit/test_sds.c and src/unit/test_zmalloc.c): it switches test assertions from s_malloc_size to s_malloc_usable_size and adds a diagnostic TEST_PRINT_INFO line. No server, replication, persistence, command, or tool code changes, so no running valkey-server or tool behaviour differs between the parent and the change; there is nothing a scenario could exercise.
